items.raw_excerpt: Cosa fare a Bologna a Natale? Scopri quali sono i mercatini, gli eventi, le esperienze e le tradizioni tipiche delle feste natalizie
items.summary_en: Bologna hosts its beloved Christmas markets with traditional stalls, festive events, and holiday experiences throughout the city center and nearby areas. Visitors can explore local crafts, seasonal foods, and authentic Italian holiday traditions during the festive season.

items.raw_excerpt: The Argentine race driver sealed arguably his best performance as a Formula 1 driver, but fueled tensions with his teammate
items.summary_en: Argentine driver Franco Colapinto delivered one of his best Formula 1 performances. However, his strong showing has created tension with his teammate at Alpine. It remains unclear if the team will continue to support his rise.
items.summary_ko: 아르헨티나 출신 드라이버 프랑코 콜라핀토가 포뮬러 1에서 커리어 최고에 가까운 경기를 펼쳤다. 그러나 인상적인 활약이 팀 동료와의 갈등을 키우고 있다. 팀이 그의 성장을 계속 지원할지는 미지수다.
items.title_en: Colapinto proves he belongs, but will Alpine let him shine?

items.raw_excerpt: Basic Education Minister, Siviwe Gwarube says the department is expanding access to early learning
items.summary_en: Basic Education Minister Siviwe Gwarube announced the department is working to expand access to early learning programs. The initiative aims to reach more young children across the country with early childhood education services.

items.raw_excerpt: For pupils in six Austrian provinces, Monday marks the end of the summer holidays and the start of a new school year. Before long, many of them will also have their first Schularbeit.
items.summary_en: For pupils in six Austrian provinces, Monday marks the end of summer holidays and the start of a new school year. Soon many of them will have their first Schularbeit. It is a German word for a written class test at school.
items.summary_ko: 오스트리아 여섯 개 주의 학생들에게 월요일은 여름방학이 끝나고 새 학년이 시작되는 날입니다. 곧 많은 학생들이 첫 Schularbeit를 치르게 됩니다. Schularbeit는 학교에서 보는 필기 시험을 뜻하는 독일어 단어입니다.
items.title_en: German Word of the Day: die Schularbeit
items.title_original: German Word of the Day: die Schularbeit

items.raw_excerpt: CPI(M) cadre in Keralam may soon access ideological clarity through new web and mobile applications launched for political education.
items.summary_en: The Communist Party of India (Marxist) is launching new web and mobile applications for its cadre in Kerala. These apps will provide political and ideological education materials. The digital tools aim to make party education more accessible to members.

items.raw_excerpt: Experts look at hardy species which may replace traditional favourites.
items.summary_en: Hotter summers mean we may need to swap thirsty garden plants for drought-tolerant ones. Experts say succulents and Mediterranean plants do well, while hydrangeas, acers and dogwoods suffered this summer. They suggest swaps like astrantias for achilleas and hydrangeas for buddleia.
items.summary_ko: 여름이 더 더워지면서 정원의 물을 많이 먹는 식물을 가뭄에 견디는 식물로 바꿔야 할 수 있다. 전문가들은 다육식물과 지중해식물이 잘 자라는 반면, 수국과 단풍나무 등은 올여름 큰 피해를 봤다고 말한다. 아스트란티아를 아킬레아로, 수국을 부들레이나로 바꾸는 식의 제안이 소개된다.
items.title_en: Plant swap: which thirsty plants can we swap for drought lovers?
